title: Historical NIFTY 50 Universe
gate_status: CONDITIONAL PASS / PROCEED WITH KNOWN LIMITATION

U-11.status: CONDITIONAL PASS / PROCEED WITH KNOWN LIMITATION
U-11.limitation: Four historically valid NIFTY 50/F&O names — HDFC, LTIM, INFRATEL/INDUSTOWER, and ZEEL — are missing from the vendor 15-minute underlying database for certain historical periods. As a result, those member-expiries were unavailable to the ranking engine and may introduce survivorship bias into historical rankings. No data has been fabricated or repaired at this stage.
U-11.instruction: Do not modify the ranking methodology to compensate for the missing data.

sources: NSE Indices press releases (niftyindices.com/Press_Release/ind_prs*.pdf): every replacement, exclusion and corporate-adjustment release 2016-01..2026-09 (462 PDFs, saved with extracted text and an index CSV in `data_validation/sources/niftyindices/`). Anchor: official `ind_nifty50list.csv` downloaded 2026-09-17. Compared against the project's `data/universe/nifty50_master_list.csv` (hand-transcribed, used by the rankings), `data/signals/expiry_rankings.csv`, and the vendor `in_nifty50` flag in `data/market/nifty50_15m.db`.
methodology: NIFTY 50 changes are parsed from the PDFs: replacement sections (`1) Nifty 50` / `a) NIFTY 50`) with their `effective from` date, and spin-off inclusions / exclusions whose index list contains Nifty 50. A later release supersedes an earlier one for the same symbol and action within 120 days (Yes Bank's exclusion was brought forward from 27-Mar to 19-Mar-2020). Membership is rebuilt by undoing every change from the anchor list, newest first; the rollback must never remove a non-member or add a member. Renames with the same ISIN are mapped to today's ticker (ZOMATO→ETERNAL, TATAMOTORS→TMPV, LTI→LTIM). `is_nifty50` is an interval lookup; the expected status is an independent forward replay of the events.
notes: Validated table: data_validation/output/nifty50_membership.csv (symbol, effective_from, effective_to, source releases); events: data_validation/output/nifty50_change_events.csv.
The 2026-09-30 change (BSE in, WIPRO out, release ind_prs10082026.pdf) is after the anchor date and after the backtest window; it is parsed but not applied.
No data was repaired in this phase.

checks.name: Project NIFTY 50 list equals NSE membership for regular constituents on every day
Project list omits zero-price spin-off inclusions (known, non-tradable)
checks.detail: ITCHOTELS: 2025-01-06..2025-02-07 (25 days); JIOFIN: 2023-07-20..2023-09-06 (34 days); KWIL: 2025-12-05..2026-02-23 (54 days); TMCV: 2025-10-14..2025-11-14 (22 days). Each was added by NSE Indices at zero price before listing and had no F&O contract, so it could never be a wheel candidate.

checks.name: Every ranked symbol was a NIFTY 50 member on its ranking expiry
Every tradable NIFTY 50 member is present in the ranking on each expiry (no survivorship gap)
checks.detail: HDFC: 45 expiries (2019-10-31..2023-06-28); INFRATEL: 12 expiries (2019-10-31..2020-09-24); LTIM: 15 expiries (2023-07-27..2024-09-26); ZEEL: 12 expiries (2019-10-31..2020-09-24). These members have no bars in the vendor 15m database (data/market/nifty50_15m.db), so scripts/wheel/expiry_rankings.py skipped them and the backtest could never select them.
